test_update_weights_from_disk: test the update_weights_from_disk API to update model weights in place without restarting the server
test_update_weights_specific_modules: test updating only specific modules like transformer or vae without affecting other modules
test_update_weights_rollback: test corrupted weights rollback to restore previous model state when update fails
test_update_weights_with_offload: test weight updates with layerwise offload enabled without shape mismatch errors
test_update_weights_error_handling: test error handling for nonexistent model paths, missing model_path, and nonexistent modules
